reviews_1s:
Unfortunately I did not realize that the lids were not going to stay on tightly until I was working on a craft project with a group of kids. Because I had a project planned for these children, I had to still use the jars even though the lids did not work properly. I hope the kids don’t end up spilling tinted water all over the place from the project when they get home. I advised parents to hold them by the jar not the lid, and perhaps glue the lid on when they get home. Very aggravating and disappointing. Had I been working with older kids I would have used glass mason jars, but was afraid small kids might drop them, and broken glass would be all over. I hoped these plastic jars would have been the perfect solution…which they would have been if they lids actually fit properly.I didn’t read the fine print. These jars are not dishwasher safe! I probably will donate them!I was very disappointed , the order was supposed to include10 jars, I needed these for a project and when I opened the box there were only 6.Almost each one didn't screw tightly, they just kept turning and turning. Jars that did seem to tighten eventually popped open, resulting in refunds I had to make to customers. Having to tape the lids to the jars shouldn't be a necessity, but it is with the gold lids. Silver and black never gave me this issue, then again they have completely different grooves.They melted when i put stuff in themI’m putting paint in these jars and the tops and jars do not match up easily to screw on. I bought another brand at the same time and they were fine. I spent way too much time trying to get the tops on.Very disappointed!! I’ve used these before, but this time not one single lid tightened all the way. I use them to sell honey at markets, so I didn’t open them till the night before the market. Very unhappy. If I could return I would, but they all now have honey in them.Very dissatisfied with the gold lid jars , they would not seal , after filling the jars with seamoss they ended up not closing , very upset, the black lids never gave me an issue , next time I will stick to those , reached out to seller to see what can be doneI wanted a non-glass Mason jar, but it needed to fit my standard lids, and it does not.
